def pancake_sort(arr):
    def flip(arr, i):
        arr[:i+1] = arr[:i+1][::-1]

    def find_max_index(arr, i):
        max_index = i
        for j in range(i, len(arr)):
            if arr[j] > arr[max_index]:
                max_index = j
        return max_index

    n = len(arr)
    for i in range(n-1, 0, -1):
        max_index = find_max_index(arr, i)
        if max_index != i:
            flip(arr, max_index)
            flip(arr, i)

    return arr
